name: Spread of the Black Death

sources.cite: Benedictow, O. J. (2004). The Black Death 1346-1353: The Complete History. Boydell Press.
Spyrou, M. A. et al. (2022). The source of the Black Death in fourteenth-century central Eurasia. Nature 606, 718-724.
Christakos, G. et al. (2005). Interdisciplinary Public Health Reasoning and Epidemic Modelling: The Case of Black Death. Springer.

what: The likely path of the Black Death from the Tian Shan to Moscow, city by city.
why: It followed the trade network: caravan roads to the Black Sea, galleys to every Mediterranean port, then rivers and roads inland.
